work_identified: Historia Coelestis Britannica, Vol. 3 (1725) — the third volume of Flamsteed's posthumous star-catalogue compilation, containing the long preface/prolegomena to the British Catalogue, historical star catalogues (Ptolemy, Ulugh Beg, Tycho Brahe, Hevelius, etc.), Flamsteed's own British star catalogue (~2,936 stars), a southern-stars supplement, and tables; distinct from Vol. 1–2 (observation logs) and from the separate Atlas Coelestis (1729)

reasoning: Vol. 3 contains the lengthy preface/prolegomena + historical catalogues + Flamsteed's own British star catalogue + tables. Only the preface has a prior English translation (Alison Dione Johnson, 1982, National Maritime Museum — partial). No complete English translation of the full volume found in WorldCat, archive.org, HathiTrust, or scholarly literature. Our rendering covers the complete volume.
